popCulture.title: Description of Greece
popCulture.creator: Pausanias
popCulture.description: Pausanias records Thebe daughter of Asopus as the eponym who gives Boeotian Thebes its name — the naiad behind the Cadmea’s city title.

popCulture.title: Asopus
popCulture.description: The river-god’s daughters name cities across Greece — Thebe among them, the Boeotian eponym who stands beside Aegina, Salamis and Sinope in the Asopid catalogue.

popCulture.title: Thébé (nymphe)
popCulture.description: Naiad daughter of Asopus — eponymous heroine of Boeotian Thebes (no dedicated English article; French Wikipedia).
